items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then, he got Joel Don to produce. I said, “Well”—I want, I wanted to do an album.

ctx.x: Right. I won the Downbeat poll for New Star/Talent Deserving Wider Recognition. At that particular time, I guess that made Nesuhi Ertegun interested. He called me to sign me to Atlantic Records. When I went in, he was going to produce me alone. Then, he got Joel Don to produce. I said, “Well”—I want, I wanted to do an album.
